name: VR Social: Virtual Reality Experience
summary:
VR-Social is a virtual reality application that offers a wide range of content—from mental relaxation to real-life scenarios—within a safe 3D environment.

Explore 360° content with your smartphone or VR headset and step into immersive 3D environments.

What We Offer
• Relaxation: Experience 360° natural environments for stress management and mental relaxation anytime, at your own pace.
• Extensive Scenario Library: Safely explore 3D environments for professional, academic, social and daily life scenarios,
